```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# The necessary packages:
library(quantmod)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)

# The stock data
symbols <- c("AAPL", "TSLA")
getSymbols(symbols, from = "2020-01-01", to = "2022-01-01")

# Extraction of adjusted prices
prices <- merge(Ad(AAPL), Ad(TSLA))
colnames(prices) <- symbols

wednesday_prices <- prices[weekdays(index(prices)) == "Wednesday"]

# Calculation of weekly returns
returns <- na.omit(ROC(wednesday_prices, type = "discrete"))
mean_returns <- colMeans(returns)
cov_matrix <- cov(returns)

# Portfolio simulation
set.seed(42)
n_portfolios <- 5000
results <- matrix(nrow = n_portfolios, ncol = 3)
weights_list <- list()

for (i in 1:n_portfolios) {
  weights <- runif(length(symbols))
  weights <- weights / sum(weights)
  weights_list[[i]] <- weights
  
  port_return <- sum(weights * mean_returns) * 52
  port_volatility <- sqrt(t(weights) %*% cov_matrix %*% weights) * sqrt(52)
  sharpe_ratio <- port_return / port_volatility
  
  results[i, ] <- c(port_return, port_volatility, sharpe_ratio)
}

# Data set for machine learning
weights_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, weights_list))
colnames(weights_df) <- symbols
results_df <- as.data.frame(results)
colnames(results_df) <- c("Return", "Volatility", "Sharpe")
data_rf <- cbind(weights_df, results_df)

# Training of Random Forest:
# We split the dataset into training (80%) and testing (20%) sets
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- sample(1:nrow(data_rf), 0.8 * nrow(data_rf))
train_data <- data_rf[train_idx, ]
test_data <- data_rf[-train_idx, ]

rf_model <- randomForest(Sharpe ~ AAPL + TSLA, data = train_data, ntree = 500)

# Evaluation of the model on the test data
test_data$predicted_sharpe <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data)
cat("Correlation (Test set):", cor(test_data$Sharpe, test_data$predicted_sharpe), "\n")

# Generation of new portfolios and predict their Sharpe ratios using the trained model
new_weights <- matrix(runif(10000 * length(symbols)), ncol = 2)
new_weights <- t(apply(new_weights, 1, function(w) w / sum(w)))
colnames(new_weights) <- symbols
new_weights_df <- as.data.frame(new_weights)
new_weights_df$predicted_sharpe <- predict(rf_model, newdata = new_weights_df)

# Identification of the portfolio with the best predicted Sharpe ratio
best_idx <- which.max(new_weights_df$predicted_sharpe)
best_weights <- new_weights_df[best_idx, ]

ggplot(data_rf, aes(x = Volatility, y = Return, color = Sharpe)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Efficient Frontier (AAPL & TSLA - Wednesdays)",
       x = "Annualized Volatility", y = "Annualized Return", color = "Sharpe Ratio") +
  theme_minimal()


cat("Best predicted weights:\n")
print(best_weights)


```
